blocks.text: Origin / creation. Experienced small beings recognized that foods, places, seasons, practice, relationships, choices, and care could open distinct developmental Paths.
Identity / human status. Cyber-pet and little-people teachers, healers, explorers, and community specialists.
Importance. They preserved evolution as lived development rather than predetermined form and protected the right to refuse a transformation.
Decline or transformation. Pathkeeping diversified into schools, guilds, settlements, and local authorities. Some branches hoarded routes or forced rare evolutions.
Final status / surviving function. No single founding order remains. Path knowledge, evolution conditions, mentorship, and later game guidance preserve the role.
